options.label: Brightness
options.hint: Makes the whole world lighter or darker. 1.00 is the normal look.

options.label: Color strength
options.hint: How vivid the colors are. 0 is black and white, 1.00 is normal, higher is more intense.

options.label: Contrast
options.hint: The gap between dark and bright areas. Higher looks punchier, lower looks softer.

options.label: Color temperature
options.hint: Slide left for cooler, bluer colors. Slide right for warmer, more orange colors. 0 is normal.

options.label: Ambient light
options.hint: The soft light that fills shadows and covered areas. Raise it to see more in the shade, lower it for deeper shadows.

options.label: Darkest light level
options.hint: Sets a floor for how dark shaded areas and caves can get. 0 allows full darkness, higher values keep things visible.

options.label: Leaf brightness
options.hint: How bright sunlit leaves look. Lower is darker and moodier, higher makes forests glow.

options.label: Clouds
options.hint: How visible the clouds are. 0 hides them completely and helps the game run faster.

options.label: Night sky
options.hint: How bright the stars and galaxy look at night. 1.00 is normal.

options.label: Shooting stars
options.hint: Occasional streaks across the night sky. Turn off if you find them distracting.

options.label: Moving water
options.hint: Gentle waves on the water surface. Off makes water look flat and is slightly faster.

options.label: Finer water waves
options.hint: Adds a second, smaller layer of waves. Looks richer but uses more GPU. Best left off on older phones.

options.label: Clouds in reflections
options.hint: Water and shiny blocks mirror the clouds. Looks great but uses more GPU.

options.label: Land in reflections
options.hint: Water and shiny blocks mirror nearby land. Looks great but uses more GPU.

options.label: Shiny block reflections
options.hint: Metal and polished blocks mirror their surroundings. Off makes them look matte and runs faster.

options.label: Sun shine on blocks
options.hint: Blocks catch bright highlights from the sun and moon. Off looks flatter and runs faster.
